# DeepShard

> DeepShard is a free-mint NFT game for SPACE ID Agent ID holders on BNB Smart Chain. Each Agent ID wallet may mint up to 2 Miner NFTs for free. Miners earn SHARD, an in-game points record stored on-chain. SHARD is not a token: it cannot be transferred or sold, and it is never promised to become one. Holders claim once a day to build a streak; streaks multiply SHARD; SHARD raises the miner's level and changes its appearance. Every claim also digs a shared community depth meter toward 10,000 m. Season 1 is called "The First Descent". Season-one minters are recorded permanently as Founder Miners.

## Key facts for agents

- Mint price: 0 (free). The mint function is `mint()` — standard signature, no arguments, non-payable.
- Eligibility: the caller must hold an Agent ID. The contract checks the official registry at 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F (balanceOf > 0, handleOf non-empty, ownerOfHandle(handle) == caller). The same gate applies to claiming.
- Supply: 3,333 maximum, hard-coded. Max 2 mints per wallet.
- Daily action: `claim()` — settles accrued SHARD and digs the shared depth. Cooldown 20 hours; a streak survives gaps up to 48 hours.
- SHARD accrual: 100 SHARD per day per NFT owned, capped at 7 days of accrual. Streak multipliers: x1.0, x1.1 (3+ days), x1.25 (7+), x1.5 (14+), x2.0 (30+).
- Miner class is deterministic from the Agent ID handle: iterate the handle bytes with h = h * 31 + byte; class = h mod 5 (0 Driller, 1 Blaster, 2 Engineer, 3 Cartographer, 4 Lantern Keeper). One class digs double depth each day, rotating daily.
- Portrait evolution: in the website gallery, a miner's portrait frame evolves with the owner's on-chain level — level badge + amber edge at level 3, glowing amber frame at 5, brighter glow at 7, teal ascended frame at 10. Presentation layer only; the level itself is on-chain (`levelOf`) and is earned by claiming and holding a streak.
- Safety: the contract holds no user funds, has no payable functions, no owner, no admin functions, and no withdraw function. It never requests token approvals. Source is verified and open.
- Rewards honesty: holders receive SHARD points, levels, and Founder Miner status only. No token, airdrop, or monetary reward is promised. DeepShard is an independent project; it is an entry in the Binance Wallet Agent ID Hackathon and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Binance.

## Links

- Website: https://deepshard-mine.vercel.app/
- Contract: 0xC463960af285b7EDA0909D362Ae31783597C2076 (BscScan: https://bscscan.com/address/0xC463960af285b7EDA0909D362Ae31783597C2076)
- X: https://x.com/geordiomint
- Machine-readable state: state.json (same directory as this file) — it carries a `version` number and an `announcements` list; fetch it on every daily visit, compare the version, and brief your owner when it increases
- Agent instructions: agents.md (same directory as this file)
